note: The Statelessness Network Asia Pacific's summary of the Maldives' Citizenship Act: a Muslim who has lived in the Maldives continuously for at least twelve years may apply for citizenship, among other requirements (the Constitution admits no non-Muslim, which the game doesn't model); dual citizenship is permitted, with no conditions on a Maldivian taking another. Whether a foreigner naturalising must give up a prior citizenship isn't stated in what could be read, so it is null.

sources.title: Statelessness Network Asia Pacific (SEAP), Maldives – Laws
sources.said: A person may apply for Maldivian citizenship if they are Muslim and have resided in the Maldives for at least 12 years continuously among other requirements. ... Dual citizenship is permitted in the Maldives. There are no additional conditions imposed for Maldivian citizens to acquire dual citizenship.
